Subject: Zenith Health — post-demo security follow-up & incident notification details

Hi Amanda / Rajiv — thanks again for taking the demo this morning. Quick recap and the security items we agreed to follow up on: 

1) SOC 2: you asked for evidence and a short summary. Attached is a 2-page SOC 2 Type II summary (full report available under NDA).

2) Incident response & breach notification: you asked for our standard timelines and what evidence we can provide for BCP/DR audits. In short:
  - Detection & Triage: internal monitoring/alerting pipeline with 24/7 on-call (mean detection typically under 2 hours; critical incidents routed immediately).
  - Containment & Remediation: aimed at containment within 8 hours for critical events; full mitigation timelines vary by scope.
  - Notification to customers: we follow contractual/regulatory windows — typically initial notification within 72 hours for incidents that affect customer data confidentiality/availability, earlier when legally required.

3) Vendor security questionnaire: you mentioned a 3rd-party vendor Q that legal will send. Monica and I will start a draft to speed responses.

Next steps / asks for you:
- Please send the vendor-requirement doc or questionnaire (if you have it now).
- If Zenith requires HIPAA-specific attestations, confirm which artifacts are required (BAA, dataflow diagrams, encryption details).

Internal notes: CCing Monica who will own the questionnaire draft; if this turns into an RFP we should loop Dev for technical evidence and Laura for contract timelines.

Thanks — I’ll attach the SOC2 summary and an excerpt of our IR playbook here for context.

Regards,

Amanda — thanks for the clear asks. See answers below and attachments with supporting artifacts. Short summary first, details/attachments after.

1) SOC 2 coverage: The attached SOC2-Type2-Summary-2024.pdf reflects our hosted Redwood API offering (the same model endpoints shown in the demo). In-scope: Redwood control plane, customer metadata services, and inference runtime. Outsourced providers in scope: AWS (EC2, S3), Cloud DB vendor for metrics; those are listed in the SOC2 report with control mappings. Exclusions: any customer-managed private deployments (VPC/on-prem) are not covered by our hosted report and require separate review.

2) Contractual notification timeline: Our standard enterprise contract language commits to "reasonable and timely" notification; we include a target of initial notification within 72 hours for incidents materially affecting customer data confidentiality or availability. We do not promise a guaranteed 72-hour contractual SLA in all plans — for customers requiring stricter timelines we accommodate via contract addenda. (See attached IR-Playbook-Redwood-Excerpt.pdf for operational timelines and the proposed 72-hour customer notification draft.)

3) HIPAA / BAA: We support HIPAA workloads on Private deployments and via a separate addendum (BAA). For hosted customers, we can enter into a BAA on a case-by-case basis—please indicate if Zenith will require a BAA for the initial pilot. I have attached a standard BAA template excerpt; Monica will coordinate full legal review with your team.

4) DR/BCP evidence: We ran three tabletop exercises in the past 12 months (April, July, Oct 2025). Executive summary attached: dates, scope, and corrective actions. We can provide anonymized post-mortem templates and test logs under NDA.

5) Named security contact: Dev Patel (dev@redwood.com, +1 415-555-0788) is our primary IR escalation contact for enterprise accounts; backup: Laura Bennett (laura@redwood.com, +1 650-555-0142).

Attachments included for your packet: SOC2-Type2-Summary-2024.pdf, IR-Playbook-Redwood-Excerpt.pdf, zenith-security-questionnaire-draft.pdf (completed in draft form). I also started the vendor questionnaire and highlighted our responses for sections 3 (IR), 5 (Data Residency), and 7 (Third-party reliance).

Next steps:
- Amanda: confirm whether Zenith needs a signed BAA for the pilot (reply to this thread).
- Amanda / Legal: if you want the full SOC2 report we can provide under NDA — Monica can send the access link.
- Monica: please finalize the questionnaire and return it to Amanda by Nov 18 (7 business days).

If useful, I can set a 30-minute walkthrough with Dev and your IT risk team to walk through the IR excerpt and timelines.

Best,
